summary: Regen BioPharma Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a court-approved settlement of a $398,740 claim by Trillium Partners LP via issuance of common or Series A preferred shares under Section 3(a)(10) of the Securities Act, with proceeds remitting 65% of net sales to the plaintiff. The filing also discloses a change in certifying accountant after Simon Edward LLP acquired BCRG Group's attest business, with no adverse audit opinions except a going-concern emphasis. These are routine legal settlement and auditor changes, not a special situation transaction.
